source_text: Primus rufus et totus pilosus — Esau; Iacob calcaneum tenens. Nomina gestis congruent.
pass_a_gloss: First red and all hairy — Esau; Jacob heel holding. Names to-deeds agree.
pass_b_english: [[The first came out red and all hairy — Esau; Jacob holding the heel >> Bible:Genesis 25:25-26]]. Names match their deeds.
